content.title: Cycle 3 Chemotherapy Review

sections.chiefComplaint: Patient presents for Cycle 3 FOLFOX evaluation. Reports mild peripheral neuropathy in fingertips.
sections.assessment: Stage III Colorectal Adenocarcinoma (cT3N1M0), tolerating oxaliplatin regimen reasonably well.
sections.plan: Continue FOLFOX Cycle 3 at 100% dose. Prescribe Gabapentin 300mg TID for neuropathy. Contact family at +91 9820123456.
